name: Posta Self-Hosted Email Platform
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0-or-later self-hosted email platform with REST API, SMTP inbound/outbound relay, templates, campaigns, webhooks and web-form ingestion; no software message quota or reset period advertised.
watch_out: Requires own PostgreSQL, Redis, storage, domain/DNS and SMTP infrastructure; outbound SMTP providers, VPS, deliverability and managed hosting may cost extra. Production deployment should run dedicated workers; AGPL network-use obligations apply.
